column1: # The steps of `just bench-i9-ladder` (bench/i9-ladder.sh), in order: one bench-i9 run each,
# the after arm against the before arm, measured by the checkout's harness. Each step's mibz2
# versions are checked against the commits' reshape/Cargo.lock before it runs.
# The pilot is PR #227's run, posted there; every other step is a mibz2 bump on master
# against the bump before it (the first against a1f2a958, the native decoder at its cap of
# 4 threads, mibz2 0.1.4), posted on the queue issue. Between each pair only
# reshape/Cargo.toml and reshape/Cargo.lock differ in what the bench measures.
# name  pr   before                                    after                                     mibz2: before  after
